Featured books

Illustrated stories built to open hard conversations.

2019 · Illustrated nonfiction

Examines racial injustice and systemic racism in the U.S., built to open conversations people usually avoid.

Silence in the World: Undefined sheds light on racial injustice in the U.S. Through insightful narratives and thought-provoking analysis, it fosters a deeper understanding of systemic inequalities. It encourages readers to confront uncomfortable truths and engage in meaningful discussions about race and justice — a call to action for awareness and change.

Download PDF

2024 · Picture book

A refugee girl’s journey teaches readers about compassion and friendship along the way.

In The Kindness Wonderland, readers follow a young refugee girl who discovers the power of kindness. Through her adventures she learns how small acts of compassion create ripples of hope. An enchanting tale that inspires children to help others — a story of friendship, displacement, and care.

Download PDF

2019 · Photo & quote collection

Stunning photos paired with quotes that spark imagination, one spread at a time.

Visual Land is a collection of photographs paired with inspiring quotes. Imagery and words intertwine, igniting imagination and stirring emotions. Each page offers a unique perspective — a journey through the transformative power of visual storytelling.

Download PDF

2019 · Children’s picture book

A baby cat spreads kindness and makes the world a little better, one page at a time.

Baby Boy is a heartwarming children’s book about a cat sharing kindness. A gently illustrated tale of compassion and empathy that teaches valuable lessons for young readers — one kind act at a time.

Download PDF

Captivating stories with a fresh perspective.

We believe stories have the power to change the world. Kartory brings you real stories that present different ways to encounter truth — so you can explore social issues and discover new perspectives, anytime, anywhere.

Truth

We take on hard issues directly, without softening them for comfort.

Authenticity

Every story we publish is honest and personally lived-in, not invented for effect.

Impact

We measure success by what changes in a reader, not by copies sold.

What we’re building toward

Two ways we think about the work, side by side.

Mission

Use real stories to drive real change.

We’re committed to exposing essential truths and diverse perspectives, so every book we publish acts as a catalyst for understanding and action — not just a nice read.

Vision

Illustration as a doorway into hard subjects.

We’re building toward a catalogue of young-adult and picture books where the art carries as much of the story as the words — mystery, fantasy, and real-world emotion, told visually.

“Stories have the power to change the world — we bring you the ones that show a different way to encounter the truth.” — Kartory’s founding belief
